about: Who calls whom in this repo. One source of truth for the skill-graph diagrams in README.md and in each <skill>/README.md. Edit this file, then run `make skill-graph`. An edge A -> B means A sends work or data to B. The rules and fields are in the docstring of scripts/gates/skill_graph.py.
where_to_start: Start with the skill that matches your question. For a new product idea, start with `idea-validation`. For a feature request, start with `spec-first-planning`. To find what broke, start with `ops-intake`. To check product metrics, start with `growth-review`.
Outside the factory path, start with `agent-ready-rails` to make a repo safe for agents, or with `feynman-walkthrough` to learn a codebase.
You start each next skill yourself. The one exception is an approved grant: with it, `factory-conductor` takes a plan to an open PR without stopping.
